title: 4Sum
constraints: Each returned quadruplet must be unique by values.

examples.explanation: Four distinct positions may contain the same value.

solutionApproaches.title: Enumerate Four Indices
solutionApproaches.complexity: Time O(n⁴), Space O(1) excluding output
solutionApproaches.explanation: Test every four-index combination and deduplicate results, which is too slow and cumbersome for repeated values.

solutionApproaches.title: Sort + Two Nested Loops + Two Pointers
solutionApproaches.explanation: Sort, fix first two with loops, use two pointers for the inner pair. Skip duplicates at each level.
